title: Gina, gwadawa da mika hannun jari da ƙa'idar tallace-tallace

say: Gina, gwadawa da mika hannun jari da aikace-aikacen tallace-tallace.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don module na biyu na No-Code App Development.

A cikin wannan module ɗin kun gina ƙa'idar gaske guda ɗaya. Alal misali, Esther tana gudanar da wani kantin sayar da kayan gona a Makurdi, tare da ma’aikatan tallace-tallace biyu. Tana so ta daina kirga jakunkuna kowace yamma.

panel.heading: App na kantin kayan agro-input na Esther

An gwada, amintattu kuma an tattara su

say: Aikace-aikacen ta za ta bin diddigin samfuran, isarwa da tallace-tallace, yi mata gargaɗi lokacin da hannun jari ya yi ƙasa, kuma a gwada shi kuma a rubuta shi ta yadda wani zai iya gudanar da shi. Duk yana aiki akan matakin samfuri na kyauta na AppSheet.

say: Bukatar shiga, kuma yi amfani da teburin masu amfani tare da matsayi don haka mai shi kaɗai ke canza farashin. Duk wanda ke da damar yin editan Google Sheet zai iya canza bayanai, don haka raba shi kawai tare da mai shi da magini.

panel.heading: Samun shiga, bayanai da amfani da layi

cards.d: Raba tare da imel ɗin ma'aikata masu suna. Mai shi ne kawai ke canza farashi da haja. Iyakance wanda ke gyara takardar.
Tattara abin da kuke buƙata kawai. Kada a taɓa tattara bayanan BVN, NIN ko katin a cikin ƙa'idar no-code.
Kwanakin layi na iya sake rubuta canje-canjen wasu. Ma'aikata suna aiki tare aƙalla kowace rana.

say: Lambobin wayar abokin ciniki bayanan sirri ne. Dokar Kare Bayanai ta Najeriya 2023 tana tsammanin ku tattara abin da kuke buƙata kawai ku kiyaye shi.

say: Don tunawa. Tsaftace takardar kuma duba kowane shafi. Yi lissafin jari, kada a taɓa buga shi. Toshe munanan shigarwar. Maimaita duk gwaje-gwaje bayan gyarawa. Kuma isar da fakitin mika hannu, ta yadda wani ba kai ba zai iya kiyaye app ɗin a raye.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Tsaftace zanen gado da farko; duba kowane shafi
Yi lissafin haja daga layuka masu alaƙa
Ingantacciyar Idan kuma Ana Bukata Tsayar da muggan shigarwar
Kunshin mikawa: samfuri, dokoki, masu amfani, farashi, gwaje-gwaje

say: Ayyukanku: gina sigar farko daga takarda mai tsabta, ƙara dabaru da bot ɗin ƙaramin jari, sannan gwadawa, amintaccen kuma rubuta kayan aikin ku.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
